findings.description: uploadAndCommit sets result.succeeded = true right after the upload lands; when the later commit() call fails, the catch block only records result.error and logs a warning but never resets succeeded back to false, so a file whose commit failed is still reported - and counted in succeededCount - as a successful upload: the commit error is swallowed behind a partial success.

summary: One defect found in this commit; see the finding above.
